subject: CS350
filterSummary: Successfully selected 5 English and 4 Arabic videos. The English selection is very strong, with top-tier creators like Jenny's Lectures, KnowledgeGATE, and Gate Smashers covering all topics with highly-viewed, relevant content. The Arabic selection is also strong, dominated by the excellent and popular series from Mohamed El Desouki for normalization topics. However, there was no suitable Arabic video specifically for 'Armstrong's Axioms'; available candidates were either on general logic or too broad, failing relevance gates.

coverage.note: No candidates specifically cover Armstrong's Axioms for databases. Shortlisted videos were either too broad (general normalization), on a different topic (inference rules for discrete math), or failed duration/relevance gates.
